title: Chuck e Cheese in your Mall World??
content: Has anyone had an abandoned chuck e cheese in your mall world? Like an old one with the animatronics? For reference I am gen z and grew up with Munch's Make Believe Band. Everything was still working, the machines were on and the animatronics were performing, but the lights were off and absolutely no one was there. The only lights that were on were the lights for the band and machines. Mine also had a school attached to it with classrooms for learning languages that don't exist/are uncommon. (Spanglish, Simlish, Piglatin, basically gibberish languages) as well as real languages. Before I looked into the school, I looked out of the front doors of Chuck e Cheese's and it was gray outside, like it was gonna storm. If I am not mistaken there were also cars moving outside. I remember waking up before I could go beyond the school. The dream was a few weeks ago so I don't remember every single detail. Anyone else has had a chuck e cheese dream like this??
